pages.title: Brane Tension Fiber
pages.text: A thread pulled from a brane, the membrane on which strings end. It is strong beyond any material, because its tension is a property of spacetime rather than chemistry. It hums faintly and pulls back toward the surface it came from.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Brane Striders walk on membranes in the Bulk, and when they fell they left these threads behind. I found more in derelict stations, still taut as if attached to something invisible.
